cohort: Two naturally arriving Gmail messages with new AI classification and completed code screening after the initial rollout drained.
source: Production structured Worker logs and read-only aggregate joins of durable label, code, work and capture records.

positiveCodeBaseline.cohort: Three approved incoming test emails with synthetic sign-in codes and full production sender history and AI context.
positiveCodeBaseline.endpoint: Later of durable label application and code processing, with exact codes and Personal labels verified in the production UI.
positiveCodeBaseline.limiter: Repeated database network and protocol waits. Matching UPDATE execution p50 was 0.076-0.109ms and p99 0.096-0.162ms in PlanetScale Insights, versus 310-344ms observed at the Worker.
positiveCodeBaseline.limitation: Small sequential before/after cohort. This baseline has three positive samples; the regional rollout must be measured separately before claiming a speedup.

limitations: Two samples do not establish a steady-state average.
Code screening completed but neither message contained a code.
Critical callback timing includes reporting after label application and differs from the saved-result interval.
Work wait includes preparation and is not pure queue transport latency.
The earlier controlled benchmark used empty sender history and no stored memories, so it did not represent this production workload.
